data.title: The drip beneath the sink
data.situation: Ten days after moving in, Lin heard a steady drip in the kitchen. The tap was leaking from a connection beneath the sink. A bowl caught most of the water, but a thin line had reached the wooden cupboard below. She wiped it dry, took a photo, and reported the fault to the landlord in a message. 'The kitchen tap is leaking, and the water may damage the cupboard. Could you arrange a repair?' she wrote. He offered an appointment with a plumber on Tuesday afternoon, when Lin would be at work. Lin replied with two times she could be home and asked him to confirm Thursday morning. She also asked whether she should leave the water off until then. On Thursday, the plumber replaced a worn washer. Lin ran the tap for a minute and checked below the sink. The wood was dry; the dripping had stopped.
data.goal: Report a household fault and its possible effect, request a repair, agree a visit time, and check the result.
data.zhSupport: 入住十天后，林发现厨房水龙头漏水，水已流到木柜边。她先擦干、拍照，再向房东说明故障和可能造成的损坏。维修人员原定周二来，但她那时上班，因此提出周四上午并要求确认。先自己报告和协商，再看参考说法。

glossary.note: the tap is leaking 直接点出设备和故障；leak 在这里是水从设备中漏出。
report a fault to someone：向负责处理的人说明具体故障。
damage 是动词；may damage 用来说明可能的后果，不把尚未发生的损坏说成事实。
arrange a repair 表示协调维修；这里的整块说法是项目根据常见词义组合的场景表达。

glossary.zh: 与水管工约好的上门时间
glossary.note: appointment 强调约定的时间，with a plumber 指上门维修的人。

glossary.zh: 确认周四上午这个时间
glossary.note: confirm a time：把约定时间核实清楚；周四只是故事中的具体时间。
英式英语中指控制水流的装置；美式英语也常说 faucet。
leak 的 -ing 形式；本故事不是泄露消息的意思。
这里指设备出现的问题；报告时应说明哪个部位、有什么现象。
可处理水管、水龙头等给排水设备问题。

glossary.zh: 液体从不该流出的地方漏出
glossary.note: 本课动词；is leaking表示正在漏水，名词a leak另可描述漏水处或事件。
采用来源动词义。may damage表达可能后果；故事未确认木柜已经损坏。
本课动词，用I would like to report说明报告具体故障，不用研究报告名词义。
约定的会面时间；本课为维修上门，可以提出改期并等待对方确认。
核实安排或信息；本课请求明确时间，不能把自己提出的时间说成已确认。

glossary.text: I cannot … on … Could we … on …?
glossary.zh: 说明时间冲突并提议另一时间
glossary.note: 先说明不可行时间，再给具体替代；could we后接动词原形，日期前常用on。
matchTexts: I cannot be home on Tuesday. Could we arrange the visit on Thursday?

glossary.zh: 通过具体观察核实问题是否解决
glossary.note: to check whether说明观察目的；核验原故障处，不仅因为换过部件就宣称修好。
matchTexts: I will look below the sink to check whether it is still leaking.

retrievalPrompts.function: Report the fault and its possible effect
retrievalPrompts.cue: There is water under the kitchen sink and it is reaching a wooden cabinet. Tell the owner what is happening and why it matters.
acceptableAnswers: I need to report a fault: the kitchen tap is leaking, and the water may damage the cupboard.
Water is coming from the tap and could damage the cupboard below. Could you look into it?
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Name the place and the visible fault, then distinguish a possible consequence from damage you have already seen.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 厨房水槽下面有水，正接近木柜。告诉业主发生了什么，以及为什么需要处理。
checks: 说具体位置与正在漏水。
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 把可见故障与可能后果分开。

retrievalPrompts.function: Ask for the right repair help
retrievalPrompts.cue: The problem needs someone who fixes water pipes. Ask the owner to send that person and say what needs fixing.
acceptableAnswers: Could you arrange a repair and ask a plumber to look at the kitchen tap?
Could a plumber come to fix the leaking tap?
retrievalPrompts.feedback: A useful request names the person or action needed and the item that is faulty.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 问题需要修理水管的人处理。请业主安排，并说明要检查什么。
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 请求应落到具体对象与动作。

retrievalPrompts.function: Negotiate and confirm a visit time
retrievalPrompts.cue: A visit is offered for Tuesday afternoon, but you are at work. Suggest Thursday morning and ask for a clear reply.
acceptableAnswers: I cannot be home on Tuesday afternoon. Could we move the appointment to Thursday morning and confirm the time?
Thursday morning would work for me. Could you confirm when the worker will come?
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Explain the conflict, propose a specific alternative, and ask the other person to confirm it.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 对方提出周二下午来，但你那时上班。改提周四上午，并请求明确答复。
checks: 请求确认，不当成已商定。
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 先解释冲突，再提出可行时间并等待确认。

retrievalPrompts.function: Check whether the fault is fixed
retrievalPrompts.cue: A worker has replaced a worn part. Explain how you will check whether water still escapes beneath the sink.
acceptableAnswers: I will run the tap for a minute and check whether it is still leaking below the sink.
I will turn on the tap and look underneath to make sure the leak has stopped.
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Check the same place where the original problem occurred; the result matters more than assuming a new part solved it.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 工人换了一个磨损部件。说明你怎样核实水槽下面还会不会出水。
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 回到原故障处核验，而不是仅凭换件就推断修好。

transferPrompt.function: Transfer fault reporting to a different room and system
transferPrompt.cue: In a student room, the heater stays cold on a winter evening. You are away on Wednesday but home Friday morning. Tell the manager what has happened, ask for help, and agree a visit time without reopening Lin's story.
acceptableAnswers: I would like to report that the heater is not working. Could you arrange a repair? I am home on Friday morning; please confirm the appointment.
The heater stays cold even when I turn it on. Could someone check it on Friday morning and confirm the time?
transferPrompt.feedback: The fault and room have changed. Keep the actions: describe what happened, ask for a remedy, and agree a time you can actually be there.
transferPrompt.cueZh: 另一间学生房的暖气在冬夜仍冷。你周三不在，周五上午在家。报告情况、请求帮助，并商定上门时间。
transferPrompt.feedbackZh: 迁移报告、请求和协调时间；不照搬漏水部件。

data.easySummary: Water is leaking below the kitchen sink. Lin tells the landlord about the fault and asks for a repair. Tuesday does not work for her, so she asks to confirm Thursday morning. After the work, she checks the same place again.
data.easySummaryZh: 厨房水槽下漏水。林告诉房东故障并请求维修。周二她不在家，所以请对方确认周四上午。维修后，她再次检查原处。
